notes: This manifest records fixture provenance, redaction posture, and expected scanner signals. It is intentionally separate from scanner output so fixture submissions can be reviewed before report snapshots change.
Synthetic fixtures are small examples shaped after common tool outputs. They are useful for parser coverage but are not evidence of client behavior.
Public-chain fixtures may contain public addresses, calldata, and contract interactions. Do not add private traces or credentials.
